theorems.statement: ∀ (n k N : ℕ) (M S : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (D : Set (Rn k)) (V₁ : Set (Rn n)) (l : Rn k → Rn n), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → S ⊆ M → V₁ ⊆ V → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 (ψ ⁻¹' S) D V₁ l → ∃ W₁ : Set (Rn N), W₁ ⊆ W ∧ ψ '' V₁ = W₁ ∩ M ∧ Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 S D W₁ (ψ ∘ l)
